text:
sean: Quick heads-up 70%: scheduling a micro-canary for engine-v4.2-quant-rc4 tonight in the late quiet window (02:45 UTC). This build includes matmul-v2 tweaks and a new int8 post-scale.
li: is this the rc4 with relaxed per-op clamping? any known thermal regressions from staging?
tara: we saw a slight mem-pressure increase on a small subset of g5-like nodes during longer sequences in staging (1000+ tokens). didn't reproduce on short traces.
sean: plan: 3% traffic for 20m, then escalate to 15% for another 20m if all green. auto-pin-and-rollback if any of the gates trip.
li: define gates pls. deploybot needs explicit numbers.
sean: gates: gpu_temp_delta_c > 7C sustained, p99 latency +30% over baseline, any OOM, eviction_rate > 0.4%, kv_cache_error_ratio > 0.15%. if two separate regions show anomalies within 12m, treat as global and rollback.
tara: add a small hysteresis: require breach for 4 consecutive 30s buckets before action. that reduces noise from sensor blips.
sre-oncall: i'm good watching alerts. prefer auto-pin but want an automatic annotation in release notes linking to the canary run id.
ops-bot: noted window 02:45-03:30 UTC, micro-canary 3%->15%, hysteresis 4x30s.
deploybot: schedule accepted. canary start ts 1732111500 (02:45 UTC). auto-bail params recorded as a blob in rollout metadata: {"gpu_temp_delta_c":"7","p99_latency_pct":"30","oom_count":"1","eviction_pct":"0.4","kv_cache_error_pct":"0.15","region_anom_count":"2","hysteresis":"4x30s"}. on trigger will pin to engine-v4.1.9 and shift traffic. will post status updates here. :gear:
li: please include a post-start smoke run: 8 conversational and 4 embeddings requests, check for deterministic tokens for the conversational sample set we store in s3://redwood-ops/canaries/1732109999/smoke/.
tara: smoke command (put in ops-runbook):
```bash
./canary-smoke.sh --bundle engine-v4.2-quant-rc4 --routes chat,embed --conv 8 --embed 4 --out s3://redwood-ops/canaries/1732109999/smoke/
```
sean: good. also record the kernel driver versions used and the quantization config id in rollout metadata (qc: qcfg-2026-03-int8-v2).
sre-oncall: if deploybot pins, tag me and i'll initiate the rollback cookbook. Quick ask: can we set a 5m manual window before final traffic sweep so we can snapshot traces?
sean: prefer auto-action to avoid half-routed traffic. suggestion: deploybot will pin immediately but hold the full sweep for 5m while capturing traces, then sweep if no quick-fix appears.
li: how do we annotate release notes? i'm adding a short bullet: "engine-v4.2-quant-rc4: matmul kernel fixes; int8 post-scale tuning; micro-canary with auto-bail and 4x30s hysteresis."
ops-bot: logging rollout metadata -> s3://redwood-ops/rollouts/1732109999/metadata.json. will also open a pre/post run artifact folder.
deploybot: confirmed. will emit live events to this thread and channel #deploy-status. standby for start. :rocket:
tara: one more: if cache mismatch errors appear without mem pressure or latency, do not auto-rollback immediately; instead, if kv_cache_error ratio > 0.5% escalate but wait for the hysteresis window. we've seen transient cache flaps fix themselves.
sean: ack. final checklist: (1) deploybot schedule + gates (done), (2) smoke script + s3 path (done), (3) oncall monitor (sre-oncall), (4) release-note blurb (li). will post full RN draft after the run.
sre-oncall: i'll be online. set my handle in deploybot notifications.
sean: thanks team 39: see you at 02:45 UTC.
